description: Independent-atom electron scattering-factor parametrizations f_e(g) in angstrom, g = |scattering vector| in 1/angstrom.

kirkland.formula: f_e(g) = sum_i a_i / (g^2 + b_i) + c_i exp(-d_i g^2), i = 1..3
kirkland.reference: Kirkland, E. J. (2010). Advanced Computing in Electron Microscopy, 2nd ed., Springer, Appendix C. doi:10.1007/978-1-4419-6533-2
